description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Four Waves,” a brand-new 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath beach home in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Designed to comfortably sleep 14, this three-story retreat gives families and groups plenty of room to come together with multiple living spaces, a beautiful chef’s kitchen and inviting outdoor spaces made for enjoying the 30A lifestyle. Start the morning with coffee on the front porch, spend the afternoon at Seacrest’s 12,000-square-foot Lagoon Pool or take the seasonal tram down to the beach. Back at home, grill fresh seafood for dinner, settle into the screened porch for the evening or let the kids claim the upstairs hangout as their own. With 7 bikes included and Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach nearby, “Four Waves” puts so much of 30A within easy reach. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Brand-New Construction with three beautifully designed levels and space for up to 14 guestsSeacrest Beach Amenities including the 12,000-square-foot Lagoon Pool, private community beach access, seasonal tram and walking trailsMultiple Living & Hangout Spaces giving families plenty of room to gather or spread outSpacious Screened Porch with outdoor sofas, al fresco dining and flat-screen TVChef’s Kitchen with stainless steel appliances, standalone ice maker and plenty of room for preparing meals together7 Bikes Included for exploring Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Scenic Highway 30A*** LIVING AREAS ***“Four Waves” was designed with gathering in mind, with several spaces throughout the home where everyone can find their own place to settle in. The main living room anchors the first floor, while upstairs offers a second lounge and a separate hangout area that is especially well suited for kids and teens.Spacious first-floor living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVSecond-floor living area with comfortable seating, flat-screen TV and kitchenette with wine cooler and sinkSeparate second-floor hangout with lounge seating, flat-screen TV, dining table for 4 and additional beverage station*** KITCHEN & DINING ***At the center of the first floor, the chef’s kitchen makes cooking for a full house feel easy. Stainless steel appliances, generous storage and plenty of prep space give you everything needed for family breakfasts, fresh seafood dinners or bringing in a private chef for a special night at home.Spacious chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample storageBreakfast bar with seating for 4Standalone ice maker for keeping drinks and beach coolers ready to goDining area with seating for 8*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Five En-suite bedrooms are spread across all three floors, giving families and groups a comfortable place to recharge with plenty of privacy at the end of the day.1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerHalf Bath: Conveniently located off the living area2nd FloorQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and spacious walk-in showerBunk Suite: Two Twin-over-Twin bunk beds and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo3rd FloorQueen Guest Suite: Two Queen beds and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR LIVING ***From quiet mornings on the front porch to dinner and a movie on the screened porch, “Four Waves” gives you plenty of ways to enjoy the coastal air without leaving home. The screened porch is especially inviting after a day at the pool or beach, with space to dine, lounge and spend the evening together.Welcoming front porch with seatingSpacious screened porch with outdoor sofas, flat-screen TV and al fresco dining for 4Gas grill just outside the screened porch for grilling steaks, fresh seafood and family favoritesSecond-floor balcony with comfortable seating for another place to relax outdoors*** LOCATION & SEACREST BEACH AMENITIES ***“Four Waves” puts you in the heart of Seacrest Beach, where some of the community’s best amenities and neighboring 30A towns are all within easy reach. Spend the day at the 12,000-square-foot Lagoon Pool, take the seasonal tram down to the beach or grab one of the 7 included bikes and head toward Rosemary Beach or Alys Beach. Peddler’s Pavilion is nearby for dining, shopping and live entertainment, while Seacrest’s walking trails and the 30A bike path make it easy to explore closer to home.12,000-Square-Foot Lagoon Pool plus private Seacrest Beach Community Beach AccessSeasonal Tram Service to the beach and Lagoon PoolMore than 1.3 miles of walking trails plus convenient access to the Scenic Highway 30A bike pathPeddler’s Pavilion nearby for casual dining, shopping, live entertainment and seasonal eventsRosemary Beach and Alys Beach nearby for restaurants, coffee, boutiques and more to explore along 30A*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs (Low-Speed Vehicles) are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest or Alys BeachThere are active cameras over the garage, on the side of the home overlooking the driveway, overlooking the front porch and at the front door*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
